title: 7.4 It's raining
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Say what the weather is doing now with It's raining. / It's snowing. / The sun is shining., ask Is it raining?, and say someone is wet.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.4 The Weather Today: A1 describes the day with an adjective (It is rainy. It is sunny.) and A1 7.10 names rain and snow; A1+ 7.4 says what the weather is doing now. The one new grammar relationship is It's + raining/snowing (the weather as an action happening now), with the question Is it raining? / Is it snowing? and the short answers Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. from A1+ 3.4. 7.2's because and 7.3's wearing come back with the weather as the reason (Ana is wearing a hat because it's snowing.). Two words are new: shining, a third thing the weather does now (The sun is shining.), and wet, what the rain does to you (Diego is wet because it's raining.). A1 7.4's cloudy returns in practice.
prerequisite: A1 7.4 rainy and sunny; A1 7.5 umbrella; A1 7.10 rain and snow; A1+ 3.4 short answers; A1+ 7.2 because; A1+ 7.3 wearing.
speaking_outcome: Say raining, snowing and shining with the stress on the first part (RAY-ning, SNOH-ing, SHY-ning); in the question, let the voice go up at the end (Is it RAI-ning?). Do not require native-like speed.
